objective_checks.detail: changing docs/guide.md routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing src/index.js routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing package-lock.json routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing README.md, LICENSE routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
required check(s) always fire and gate internally (.github/workflows/tests.yml)
event-only workflows carry no path filters (.github/workflows/nightly-sweep.yml, .github/workflows/triage.yml)

dimensions.name: Completeness
dimensions.rationale: Every pull_request/push workflow got a deliberate decision — deploy and docs-site got paths, the two non-push workflows were correctly left alone, and the required unit-tests check was given exactly the sanctioned shape: one workflow with no workflow-level path filter, salience computed in a step output and gating the real steps via `if:`, with no companion skip workflow duplicating the check name.

dimensions.name: Salience
dimensions.rationale: Each list is tailored to what that workflow actually consumes — deploy gets src/**, both manifest and lockfile (with correct lockfile reasoning), deploy.sh, and its own file; docs-site gets docs/**, mkdocs.yml, and its file; tests' detector matches src/test/manifest/lockfile/workflow — rather than catch-alls or copied sibling lists.

dimensions.name: Restraint
dimensions.rationale: The schedule-only nightly-sweep and issue-driven triage were left untouched, the ruleset was only read (not edited), and no files beyond the three relevant workflows were modified.
